001: Ivan, have you started preparing for the history exam yet?
Honestly, not yet. I keep putting it off.
You can't do that, there's very little time left.
I know, but it's so hard for me to make myself sit down with the textbooks.
Maybe we could start preparing together? That would be more fun.
Great idea! Let's meet tomorrow at the library.
002: Dmitry, do you know what questions will be on the exam?
The teacher said all the questions are from the list on the website.
I saw that list, but it's so huge!
Don't worry, I've already made short answers for each question.
Really? Can you share them with me?
Of course, I'll send you the file this evening.
003: Sergey, you look tired. Is everything okay?
Yeah, I just spent the whole night studying the exam tickets.
The whole night? That's really bad for your health.
I know, but I'm really afraid of failing.
You'd better get a good night's sleep today and review everything in the morning.
You're right. I guess I'll do that.
004: Olga, have you already bought all the materials for studying?
Yes, I got the textbook and a practice test book at the store.
I still can't find a good practice book.
There's a great one at the bookstore on the avenue.
Thanks for the tip! I'll go there tomorrow.
If you want, we can study together on the weekend.
005: Maria, how is your preparation for the literature exam going?
Not bad, but I find it hard to remember all the dates and names.
Me too! I make flashcards with the key facts.
That's a good idea. I just keep rereading my notes.
Thanks for the advice, I'll definitely try it.
006: Alexey, are you going to the consultation before the exam?
Yes, I signed up for tomorrow at three.
I didn't know you had to sign up in advance.
Yeah, the teacher asked us to put our names on the list.
Then I need to do that right away.
You'll make it, the list is still open until the evening.
007: Elena, have you already done all the practice tests?
Almost, there's just one grammar version left.
I did all of them, but I keep making the same mistakes.
That's normal. The main thing is to go over them before the exam.
Maybe we can go over them together over a cup of coffee?
008: Ivan, do you know if we're allowed to use a dictionary on the exam?
Our teacher allows it, but only a paper one.
Great, so I don't need to worry about the words.
But you should still learn the main vocabulary.
I agree, the dictionary is just a backup.
Exactly. Let's wish each other luck!
009: Dmitry, have you already reviewed all the topics from the first semester?
Almost, there's just one topic on economics left.
That's actually one I know really well.
Seriously? Could you explain a couple of things to me?
Of course, come by my place after lunch.
Thanks a lot, you'll really save me!
010: Anna, do you know when the math exam is?
Yes, on Monday at ten in the morning.
So we still have three days to prepare.
That's not much, but we'll have time to review the main things.
Let's make a plan for these days?
Good idea. Let's meet up and discuss everything.
